QF.id: Cat III AIF Overview and Growth_37

question.text: A recent classification criterion introduced by SEBI is:

answer.text: Specified AIF (for funds that don't fall under Cat I/II/III; regulations to be laid out)

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 5.2.1, SEBI has introduced 'Specified AIF' category; regulations are to be separately laid out. The Trap: Other classifications don't exist as SEBI categories. Cross-Exam Context: Emerging SEBI framework. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Monitor SEBI for Specified AIF regulatory updates.
